title: Grow the demo cohort intake
metric: Take the incoming cohort from 180 to 240 students without loosening the admissions bar. Measured on enrolled, fee-paid students at the census date.

title: Hold placement conversion above 92%
metric: Conversion is offers accepted divided by students eligible, measured four weeks after the final placement week.

title: Close the two open leadership seats
metric: Both the Placement Manager and the Admission Counsellor roles filled and onboarded before the quarter closes.

title: Applications up 30% year on year
metric: Counted on completed applications, not enquiries. Duplicate and test submissions are excluded.

title: Cut time-to-decision to 5 working days
metric: Median working days from "application complete" to decision released. Tracked weekly, reported monthly.

title: Counsellor quality score above 4.5
metric: Post-call survey, five-point scale, minimum 200 responses for the score to count.

title: Sign 25 new recruiters
metric:
1. Build the target list from the sector map
2. Run the outreach sequence
3. Convert 25 to a signed MoU
Only recruiters who have not hired from us before count toward the 25.

title: Median package up 12%
metric: Median, not mean, so a handful of outliers cannot carry the number.

title: Own the North region funnel
metric: Full ownership from first enquiry to enrolment for the North region, including counsellor allocation.

title: Weekly funnel reporting
metric: Publish the funnel dashboard every Monday before 11am with commentary on anything that moved more than 10%.

title: Run the mock interview programme
metric: Six rounds per student across the quarter, each with written feedback returned inside 48 hours.

title: Ship the cohort dashboard v2
metric: Design sign-off, build, QA and release. Success is 80% weekly active use by programme staff.

title: Retire the legacy attendance sheet
metric: Everything moved onto the product, the spreadsheet archived and read-only.

title: Rebuild the demo brand kit
metric: Typography, colour and component library delivered as a Figma library with usage notes.

title: Twelve long-form posts
metric: Three per month, each reviewed before publishing.

title: Grow newsletter opens to 38%
metric: Baseline is 31%. Measured on the rolling four-send average.
